key_insight: The paper builds a large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for more than 2,500 stable halide double perovskites, revealing many candidates with visible-range band gaps and half-metallic behavior.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates materials screening for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, radiation detection, and spintronic or magnetic device design in halide double perovskites.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations of spin-polarized density of states for Cs2BB'X6 compounds
Screening of compounds predicted stable by the tau tolerance factor across X = I, Br, Cl, F
Lobster-based chemical-bonding analysis plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a database covering >2,500 compounds, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 with half-metallic character.
watch_item: The database is limited to compounds predicted stable by the tau tolerance factor and to computed properties, so experimental validation is still needed before device use.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
